duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَى وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbij alnee muqeemos Salaati wa min zurriyyatee Rabbanaa wa taqabbal du'aaa'. Rabbanagh fir lee wa liwaalidaiya wa litmu'mineena Yawma yaqoomul hisaab
duas.translation: O my Lord! make me one who establishes regular Prayer, and also (raise such) among my offspring O our Lord! and accept Thou my Prayer. O our Lord! cover (us) with Thy Forgiveness me, my parents, and (all) Believers, on the Day that the Reckoning will be established!

duas.transliteration: Rabbanaca innanaa saminaa munaadiyai yunaadee Ill eemooni an oaminoo bi Rabblikum fa aamannaa; Rabbanaa faghfir landa zunoobanca wa kaffir annaa saiyi aatina wa tawaffanaa ma'al abraar. Rabbanaa wa aatinaa maa wa'attanan 'alaa Rusulika wa laa tukhzinga Yawmal Qiyaamah: Innaka laa tukhliful mee aad
duas.translation: Our Lord! we have heard the call of one calling (Us) to Faith, Believe ye in the Lord, and we have believed. Our Lord! Forgive us our sins, blot out from us our iniquities, and take to Thyself our souls in the company of the righteous. Our Lord! Grant us what Thou didst promise unto us through Thine messengers, and save us from shame on the Day of Judgment: For Thou never breakest Thy promise.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبَتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَأَنصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanagh fir landa zunoobanda wa israafanda feee amrinaa wa sabbit aqdaarianaa wansurmaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen
duas.translation: Our Lord! Forgive us our sins and anything We may have done that transgressed our duty. Establish our feet firmly, and help us against those that resist Faith

duas.arabic: لا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Loa yukalliful-laahu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa, lahaa maa kasabat wa 'alaihaa maktasabat, Rabbanaa laa tugakhiznada in naseenaga aw akhtaanaa, Rabbanaa wa laa tahmil-alainaga isran kamaa hamaltahoo alal-lazeena min qablinaa: Rabbanaa wa laa tuhammilnaa maa loa taaqata lanaa bin; watu annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaa Anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen
duas.translation: On no soul doth Allah Place a burden greater than it can bear. It gets every good that it earns, and it suffers every ill that it earns. (Pray) 'Our Lord! Condemn us not if we forget or fall into error; our Lord! Lay not on us a burden Like that which Thou didst lay on those before us: Our Lord! Lay not on us a burden greater than we have strength to bear. Blot out our sins , and grant us forgiveness . Have mercy on us. Thou art our Protector, Help us against those who stand against faith.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا ءَامَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaaa innanaaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa zuncobanaa wa qinda azaaban Naar
duas.translation: Our Lord! we have indeed believed: forgive us, then, our sins, and save us from the agony of the Fire

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa alaika tawakkalnaa wa llaika anabnaa wa ilaikal maseer
duas.translation: Our Lord! in Thee do we trust, and to Thee do we turn in repentance to Thee is (our) Final Goal.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa zajamnaaa anfusanaa wa illam taghfir langa wa tarhamnaa lanakoonarına minal khaasireen
duas.translation: Our Lord! We have wronged our own souls: if thou forgive us not and bestow not upon us Thy Mercy, we shall certainly be lost.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbigh fir warham wa Anta khairur raahimeen
duas.translation: O my Lord! grant Thou forgiveness and mercy for Thou art the Best of those who show mercy!

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanagh fir lanaa wa li ikhwaani nal lazeena sabqoonaa bil eemaani wa laa tajal fee quloobinaa ghillalil lazeena aamanoo rabbannaaa innaka Ra'oofur Raheem
duas.translation: Our Lord! Forgive us, and our brethren who came before us into the Faith, and leave not, in our hearts, rancour (or sense of injury) against those who have believed. Our Lord! Thou art indeed Full of Kindness, Most Merciful.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana laa taj'alnaa fitnatal lillazeena kafaroo waghfir lanaa rabbanaa innaka antal azeezul hakeem
duas.translation: Our Lord! Make us not a (test and) trial for the Unbelievers, but forgive us, our Lord! for Thou art the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innee zalamtu nafsee faghfir lee
duas.translation: O my Lord! I have indeed wronged my soul! Do Thou then forgive me!
